verdict.rationale: OpenHands documents choosing a specific model: it is model-agnostic, works with any LLM, supports bring-your-own LLM keys, and OpenHandsAgentSettings lets you define an agent's model. The evidence never describes an automatic model-selection mode or a user-facing control to switch away from one, so only the 'pick a specific model' half of the story is shown. Missing for 10: documented automatic model-selection mode, explicit UI/CLI control to override auto-selection with a chosen model, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can switch away from automatic model selection to a specific model of my choice

citations.quote: `OpenHandsAgentSettings` gives you a structured, serializable way to define an agent's model, tools, and optional subsystems like the condenser.
OpenHands Open Source and OpenHands Cloud plans offer support to bring your own LLM keys.
